title: Office Manager/Administrator- Edinburgh - 4 day week
description:
Meraki Talent is delighted to be supporting one of the fastest growing companies in Scotland in their search for a part time Business Administrator. This is initially on a temporary 4 day basis due to rapid growth with the opportunity to be made permanent after the 3 month mark.

The Company

This is a specialist sustainability business who have gone from strength to strength, doubling in size and receiving a billion pound investment from a global investment fund.

The Role:

The Business Administrator will report to the HR Director and provide administration and coordination across all areas of the business as well as engaging with external stakeholders. Duties include:
- Edinburgh office management providing day-to-day administrative support to the business,
- Prepare expense submissions for the CEO, his direct reports
- Support with ad-hoc travel and accommodation booking
- Maintain accurate records, databases, and filing systems
- Meet and escort visitors
- Prepare reports, presentations, and correspondence for internal and external stakeholders
- Point of contact for queries, directing issues to the appropriate teams
- Monitoring, reviewing and ordering of office management supplies including stationery
- General office management and admin duties

What is on Offer:
- 30k -£35k
- 3/4 day week option
- 230pm Friday finish
- Flexibility
- 34 days hols
- Opportunity to join one of the most exciting companies in Scotland
- People first and supportive environment
- Non Corporate

Candidate Profile:
- Previous experience as Business admin/Exec assistant or Office management
- It would be beneficial to have knowledge of Sage, HR functions and providing support across multiple teams

Next Steps:

This is likely to be a role with a strong interest and a high response so early applications are encouraged. Please don't hesitate to contact Dylan McGinley for a private & confidential discussion.

title: Legal Administrator
description:
Legal Administrator - Land and Rural

Location: Edinburgh
Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time

The Opportunity

An established professional services organisation is seeking a highly organised and proactive Legal Administrator to join its specialist property and rural affairs team based in Edinburgh.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to become part of a busy and supportive legal environment, providing comprehensive administrative support across a varied caseload involving property transactions, estate matters, leasing arrangements, renewable energy projects, and other land-related work.

Key Responsibilities

Client Onboarding & Compliance
- Support the onboarding of new clients and matters.
- Prepare engagement documentation and client care correspondence.
- Assist with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Client (KYC) requirements.
- Maintain accurate client records and compliance documentation.

Matter Administration
- Open and maintain client files using the firm's case management systems.
- Prepare reports and update matter information as required.
- Ensure all documentation is recorded and managed accurately.
- Maintain electronic and manual filing systems.

Transactional & Property Support
- Request and prepare property searches and related documentation.
- Assist with registration documentation and submissions.
- Prepare Land and Buildings Transaction Tax (LBTT) returns and associated paperwork.
- Provide administrative support throughout property and land transactions.

Document Production
- Produce professional correspondence, reports, forms and legal documents.
- Format, proofread and edit documentation to a high standard.
- Undertake audio typing and dictation where required.
- Prepare presentations, meeting materials and supporting documentation.

Team Support
- Coordinate diary management and scheduling of appointments.
- Arrange travel and accommodation where required.
- Liaise professionally with clients, external contacts and internal stakeholders.
- Assist with the review and continuous improvement of departmental processes and procedures.
- Provide general administrative support to the wider team.

Person Specification

Essential Experience & Skills
- Previous experience in an administrative role within a legal, professional services or corporate environment.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work to deadlines.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Word, Excel and Outlook.
- Experience producing and editing professional documents.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- Professional and client-focused approach.

Desirable Experience
- Previous experience within a legal administration or legal secretary role.
- Experience supporting property, conveyancing or rural business matters.
- Familiarity with case management systems.
- Understanding of AML and client onboarding processes.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Opportunity to work within a well-established and respected professional services environment.
- Structured training and development opportunities.
- Supportive team culture.
- Long-term career progression prospects.

title: Credit Controller
description:

Interested? Apply now or get in touch with Iconic Resourcing to find out more.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Could your eye for detail help strengthen financial controls and keep month-end running smoothly as an Accounts Assistant?

The Organisation

Join a growing Edinburgh-based company that values accuracy, integrity and strong working relationships. You will work in a supportive finance team with opportunities to develop your skills and progress your career.
- Support a growing organisation with a strong focus on long-term relationships.
- Work in an inclusive culture that values collaboration and personal growth.
- Contribute to a finance function that is improving processes and automation.
- Earn a competitive salary with ample room for progression within the business

The Role

As an Accounts Assistant, you will support accurate accounts payable and month-end processes. Your work will help the team produce reliable financial information and maintain effective controls.
- Process supplier invoices and employee expense claims, checking coding and approvals.
- Maintain supplier records and support supplier onboarding and amendments.
- Prepare payment runs, ledger allocations and related reconciliations.
- Post journals, accruals and other month-end accounting adjustments.
- Complete balance sheet, ledger and suspense account reconciliations.
- Respond to supplier and colleague queries and support finance projects.

The Ideal Candidate

You will be organised, analytical and confident working to deadlines. This role suits someone who enjoys solving problems, working with detail and collaborating across a business.

Mandatory
- Demonstrate previous experience in finance, accounts payable or financial control.
- Show experience supporting month-end activities and meeting reporting deadlines.
- Apply strong attention to detail, communication and problem-solving skills.

Preferred
- Understand invoice processing, payment workflows, journals and reconciliations.
- Use Excel confidently, with experience of Power Query, Copilot or Power BI.
- Show interest in working towards a relevant professional accounting qualification.

On Offer

The organisation supports hybrid working and will consider flexible working requests. The successful candidate will receive support with professional development and gain exposure to wider finance activity.
- Develop your career within a growing Edinburgh-based company.
- Work closely with colleagues across finance and the wider organisation.
- Gain exposure to process improvement, automation and business change.
- Receive support towards a relevant professional accounting qualification.
- Discuss flexible working arrangements during the recruitment process.

title: Procurement Assistant

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
The Company
Able Bridge Recruitment are thrilled to be working with an independent business which is part of a widder international engineering conglomerate in the recruitment of an accountants assistant on a 6 month contract.

Benefits include
Generous pension
Career development
Free on sight parking
Training

This vacancy, the result of a permanent employee being medically unwell, and will be office based in East Lothian for 6 months and will report into the finance manager.

The Responsibilities
The purpose of this role is to be accountable for the smooth and efficient running of the transactional elements of the accounting function. You will be responsible for liaising with internal stakeholders as well as dealing with suppliers in resolving queries.

On a day-to-day basis you can expect to be responsible for the following;
Processing and issuing sales invoices to group companies.
Processing purchase invoices accurately and efficiently.
Liaising with the procurement team and suppliers to resolve invoice queries
Assisting with supplier payment runs and ensuring invoices are paid on time.
Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the day-to-day activities of the finance team.

The Requirements
We are looking for an experienced accounts assistant (minimum of 3 years of experienced based in the UK), who is available immediately or at short notice. Our client is based in a rural location so a driver's licence and access to a vehicle is essential. Ideally candidates will have an accounting qualification, however candidates who are qualified by experience will be considered. Our client has a small and dedicated finance team and as such we are looking for individuals who are team players and who will roll their sleaves up in supporting the business in a widder context.

Our client does not hold a license to offer study support so will only consider applicants who are able to work unrestricted within the UK and who are based in the immediate vicinity.

If you are interested in hearing more detail about this role or would like to have a confidential chat about a potential career move, please do not hesitate in contacting me.
